recipes.title: Butter Chicken
recipes.desc: Creamy, rich and aromatic chicken curry perfect with naan or rice.
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices for 20 minutes.
Cook chicken until lightly charred and set aside.
Cook tomato puree with butter and spices.
Add chicken and simmer for 15 minutes.
Finish with cream and garam masala.

recipes.title: Masala Dosa
recipes.desc: Crispy South Indian dosa filled with fragrant potato masala.
steps: Prepare a spiced potato filling with onion and curry leaves.
Heat a flat pan and spread batter into a thin circle.
Drizzle oil and cook until crisp.
Place potato masala in the centre and fold.

recipes.title: Paneer Tikka
recipes.desc: Smoky, colourful paneer skewers with a tangy yogurt marinade.
steps: Mix yogurt, masala, lemon and oil.
Coat paneer and vegetables and marinate 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or air-fry until golden and lightly charred.

recipes.title: Mango Cheesecake
recipes.desc: A creamy no-bake cheesecake with bright tropical mango flavour.
steps: Crush biscuits and combine with melted butter.
Press into a cake tin and chill.
Whip cream and fold into cream cheese, sugar and mango.
Pour over the base and chill for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Biryani
recipes.desc: Fragrant basmati rice layered with spices, herbs and tender chicken.
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt and biryani spices.
Parboil rice with whole spices.
Cook chicken until nearly done.
Layer rice over chicken with fried onions and herbs.
Cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chole
recipes.desc: North Indian chickpea curry packed with warming spices.
steps: Sauté onion until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes.
Add chole masala and cook until fragrant.
Add chickpeas and simmer for 20 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve.
